# Merlay 0.6.1 — Flowchart syntax robustness, nested subgraph fixes, and canvas DOM hit-testing polish

> **Mermaid, your way.** A visual overlay editor for Mermaid diagrams.

## 🔧 Fixes & Polish

- **Flowchart Delimiter & Quote Escaping**: Full round-trip parsing and AST support for escaped brackets (e.g. `[label \] with bracket]`) and quotes inside node labels.
- **Edge Tokenizer & Operator Lookahead**: Fixed edge operator disambiguation in the lexer so hyphens in markdown or hyphenated identifiers are never misidentified as connectors.
- **Nested Subgraph Lifecycles & Nesting**: Moving nodes into, out of, or between nested groups now cleanly dissolves empty intermediate groups without leaving dangling shells or breaking grandparent nesting.
- **Subgraph Inline Styles**: Preserved inline subgraph styles (`style <subgraphId> ...`) across edits and serializations, including custom fill, border color, and stroke patterns.
- **Edge Reconnection & Reversal**: Preserved edge labels, line types (solid, dotted, thick), and arrowheads during interactive drag-reconnections and directional reversals.
- **Canvas Hit-Testing & Prefix Collision Fixes**: Fixed an issue where node or cluster IDs that share a prefix (e.g. `step` and `step-2` or `group` and `group-nested`) could collide in SVG element matching. Candidate IDs are now sorted descending by length with strict boundary checks.
- **Empty Subgraph Selection**: Added text fallback binding so empty or degraded subgraphs without child nodes can still be selected, inspected, and manipulated visually.

## Install (Obsidian)

**BRAT (Beta):** Add `https://github.com/dev-hashemi/merlay` in BRAT → Add Beta plugin.

**Manual:** Download `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` from the assets below into your vault under `.obsidian/plugins/merlay/`, then enable **Merlay** under Settings → Community plugins.

Requires Obsidian `1.4.0` or newer. Desktop and mobile supported.

## Install (VS Code)

Install from the [VS Code Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=dev-hashemi.merlay) or [Open VSX](https://open-vsx.org/extension/dev-hashemi/merlay), or grab the `.vsix` attached below → *Extensions → … → Install from VSIX*.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dev-hashemi/merlay/compare/0.6.0...0.6.1
